text:
Lina: Quick check-in: marketplace bundle for the LangChain gateway adapter  what do we need to hand off to the marketplace team?
Omar: We need three artifacts: adapter binary, minimal sample app, and a short security checklist. Also customer-facing docs (1-pager).
Priya: For the sample app, recommend a tiny connector that shows session pinning + routing. Keeps people from misconfiguring.
Carlos: For the adapter binary, can we publish both a docker image and a terraform module? Ops prefer terraform examples for routing.
Zoe: UX note: marketplace listing must include screenshots, a 30s demo GIF, and a one-line TL;DR. Marketplace also wants a logo at 512px.
Lina: Good. Legal constraints? @legal-bot any IP or wording restrictions for co-branded assets?
legal-bot: Flag: if using partner logos, get explicit written permission. For open-source connectors, include an SPDX license in repo. Avoid claims like "certified" unless we have a signed partner MOU.
Priya: Technical checklist draft: 1) session propagation tested 2) KV cache namespace stable across reconnects 3) streaming tested for 1..12 concurrent streams 4) model pinning example 5) graceful downgrade path.
Omar: QA added a pass/fail test matrix in CI: s3://redwood-partners/marketplace/lc-gateway/matrix-1998887776.csv. Please review before we publish.
eng-qa: Noted. We'll add a flaky test guard for streaming>8 concurrency and fail the build on >3% tail latency regressions.
Carlos: Who owns announcement copy? I can draft brief for marketplace blurb, but marketing should approve the blog headline.
Zoe: I'll coordinate with marketing. Suggest: two assets - short marketplace blurb + deeper tech note for the partner blog. Keep the blurb conservative per legal.
Lina: Timeline? Target marketplace listing by end-of-next-week. That means all assets in our shared drive by Wed EOD.
Priya: Also request: add a small migration snippet showing how to update headers to propagate session id. Minimal code example the SI can copy.
Carlos: Example snippet (Python):
```
# copy session id to routing header
def middleware(req, res):
    sid = req.headers.get('x-session-id')
    if sid:
        req.headers['x-routing-key'] = sid
    return next(req)
```
Zoe: Marketing asked for one real customer quote. Do we have anyone from the pilot willing to be quoted?
Lina: We have a pilot contact at Acme Health willing to provide a short blurb if legal OKs it. @legal-bot to confirm.
legal-bot: Confirmed: we can use a 1-2 line customer quote with written sign-off. Save the sign-off email in the partnership folder.
Omar: Hardware partners note: include recommended instance families in the marketplace docs. List: H100(large-batch), A100-v3(recommended for KV-heavy), T4(not recommended for high-concurrency). Add a footnote about driver versions.
Priya: Action items: 1) produce sample app (Priya) 2) terraform + docker image (Carlos) 3) marketplace assets + screenshots (Zoe) 4) legal sign-off + quote (Lina + legal-bot) 5) CI perf gate (eng-qa).
Lina: I'll capture these into the partner playbook and share a link. One more ask: include a "Known Limitations" section that explicitly notes the async callback caveat and the need for global cache namespace. Keep it visible.
Carlos: I'll add a short rollout checklist for SIs: enable test workspace, run quick smoke, validate logs for routing headers, rollback steps.
Zoe: Scheduling: quick review sync Thu 9am PT. Calendar invite sent.
Lina: Thanks everyone. Keep threads short for the marketplace PR. We'll iterate on the draft in the doc I shared: drive.google.com/drive/folders/marketplace-lc-gateway-1998887776 :raised_hands:
